cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a quiet memorial hall aboard a starship — kneeling on the ground; a windswept coastal bluff with a low grassy path and an empty kite-flying area — reading the changing wind before letting a simple diamond kite rise higher; an underground subway platform — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a private orbital passenger cabin with an oval window and a fabric sleeping hammock — taking a quiet break while letting a folded paper star float gently between her hands; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a neon-lit game arcade — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing; a Three Kingdoms festival street — kneeling on the ground; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — standing; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — brushes her hair with a hairbrush; a neon-lit game arcade — perched on a ledge or edge; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck
